Adrenaline Rush.desc: Increases your Energy regeneration rate by 100% for 15 sec.

Agonizing Flames.desc: Increases the critical strike chance of your Searing Pain spell by 10% and the damage done by all your Destruction spells by 10%.

Aimed Shot.desc: An aimed shot that increases ranged damage by 20. Aimed Shot shares its cooldown with Multi-Shot.

Amplify Curse.desc: Increases the effect of your next Curse of Weakness or Bane of Agony by 50%, or your next Curse of Exhaustion by 20%. Lasts 30 sec.

Anger Management.desc: Generates 1 Rage every 3 sec while in combat, and reduces Rage loss while out of combat by 30%.

Aquatic Form.desc: Shapeshift into Aquatic Form, increasing swim speed by 50% and allowing the druid to breathe underwater. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects. The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

Arcane Focus.desc: Improves your chance to hit with Arcane spells by 2%.

Arcane Impact.desc: Increases the critical strike chance of your Arcane spells by 6%.

Arcane Intellect.desc: Increases the target's Intellect by 2 for 3600 sec.

Arcane Meditation.desc: Allows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

Arcane Mind.desc: Increases your Intellect by 10% and increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Arcane spells by 100%.

Arcane Missiles.desc: Launches Arcane Missiles at the enemy, causing 24 Arcane damage each second for 3 sec.

Arcane Shot.desc: An instant shot that causes 20 Arcane damage.

Arcane Subtlety.desc: Reduces your target's resistance to all your spells by 15 and reduces the threat caused by your Arcane spells by 30%.

Armorsmith.desc: Allows a blacksmith to make special armors that are unavailable to the typical artisan blacksmith.

Aspect of the Beast.desc: The hunter takes on the aspects of a beast, becoming untrackable and increasing Melee Attack Power by 50. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

Aspect of the Hawk.desc: The hunter takes on the aspects of a hawk, increasing Ranged Attack Power by 20. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

Aspect of the Monkey.desc: The hunter takes on the aspects of a monkey, increasing chance to dodge by 8%. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

Auto Shot.desc: Automatically shoots the target until cancelled.

Axe Specialization.desc: Increases your damage with One-Handed Axes by 1.

Bait and Tackle.desc: Allows the fisher to add features to a wilderness camp.

Bane of Doom.desc: Afflicts the target with impending doom, causing 1742 Shadow damage after 60 sec. If the target dies from this damage, there is a chance that a Doomguard will be summoned. Cannot be cast on players. Only one Bane per Warlock can be active on any one target.

Bane of Havoc.desc: Afflicts the target for 300 sec, causing 15% of all damage done by the Warlock to other targets to also be dealt to the cursed target. Bane of Havoc is limited to 1 target, and only one Bane per Warlock can be active on any one target.

Banish.desc: Banishes the enemy target, preventing all action but making it invulnerable for up to 20 sec. Only one target can be banished at a time. Only works on Demons and Elementals.

Barkskin.desc: Your skin becomes as tough as bark. Physical damage taken is reduced by 20%. While you are protected, damaging attacks will not cause spellcasting delays. Lasts 15 sec.

Barrage.desc: Increases the damage done by your Multi-Shot, Aimed Shot, and Volley abilities by 15%.

Bastion.desc: Increases all damage you deal by 10% while a shield is equipped.

Benediction.desc: Reduces the Mana cost of all instant cast spells and abilities by 10%.

Berserker Rage.desc: The warrior enters a berserker rage, becoming immune to Fear and Incapacitate effects and generating extra rage when taking damage. Lasts 10 sec.

Berserker Stance.desc: An aggressive stance. Critical strike chance increased by 3% and all damage taken is increased by 10%.

Bestial Discipline.desc: Increases the Focus regeneration of your pets by 100% and allows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

Bestial Swiftness.desc: Increases the movement speed of your pets by 30%.

Binding Heal.desc: Heals a friendly target and the caster for 247. Low threat.

Blade Flurry.desc: Increases your melee attack speed by 20% and your melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent. Lasts 15 sec.

Blast Wave.desc: A wave of flame radiates outward from the caster, damaging all enemies caught within the blast for 163 Fire damage, and Dazing them for 50% reduced movement speed for 6 sec.

Blessing of Kings.desc: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, increasing total stats by 10% for 3600 sec. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

Blessing of Might.desc: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, increasing melee attack power by 14 for 3600 sec. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

Blessing of Salvation.desc: Places a Blessing on the party member, reducing the amount of all threat generated by 30% for 3600 sec. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

Blind.desc: Blinds the target, causing it to wander disoriented for up to 10 sec. Any damage caused will remove the effect.

Blink.desc: Teleports the caster 20 yards forward, unless something is in the way. Also frees the caster from Stuns and Immobilizes.

Blood Fury.desc: Increases Attack Power and Spell Power by 10% for 15 sec.

Bloodlust.desc: Increases an ally's attack speed by 30% for 30 sec.

Bloodthirst.desc: Instantly attack the target causing damage equal to 35% of your Attack Power plus 30 and increasing your movement speed by 10% for 10 sec.

Booming Voice.desc: Increases the radius of your Battle Shout and Demoralizing Shout abilities by 50%.

Bountiful Harvest.desc: You discover 100% more Scarce materials from Mining, Herbalism, and Skinning.

Burning Soul.desc: Gives your Fire spells a 70% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage and reduces the threat caused by your Fire spells by 30%.

Call of Flame.desc: Increases the damage done by your Fire Totems and by your Flame Shock, Fire Nova, and Lava Burst spells by 15%.

Call of Thunder.desc: Increases the critical strike chance of your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells by 3%.

Call of the Elements.desc: Simultaneously places up to 4 totems specified in the Totem Bar.

Careful Aim.desc: Increases your Attack Power by 100% of your Intellect.

Cataclysm.desc: Reduces the Mana cost of your Destruction spells by 10%.

Challenging Roar.desc: Forces all nearby enemies to focus attacks on you for 6 sec.

Champion of the Light.desc: Increases your spell damage by up to 100% of your Intellect.

Cleave.desc: A sweeping attack that does your weapon damage plus 5 to the target and a second nearby enemy.

Cold Blood.desc: When activated, increases the critical strike chance of your next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, Eviscerate, or Mutilate by 100%.

Cold Snap.desc: Finishes the remaining cooldown on all your other Frost spells.

Concussion.desc: Increases the damage done by your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Earth Shock spells by 1%.

Concussive Shot.desc: Dazes the target, slowing movement speed by 50% for 4 sec.

Conflagrate.desc: Ignites a target that is already afflicted by your Immolate spell, dealing 95 Fire damage and consuming your Immolate effect.

Conjure Mana Agate.desc: Conjures a mana agate that can be used to instantly restore 400 mana. Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

Convection.desc: Reduces the mana cost of your Shock, Lightning Bolt, Lava Burst, and Chain Lightning spells by 2%.

Conviction.desc: Improves your chance to get a critical strike with melee attacks by 5%.

Counterattack.desc: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 50% weapon damage plus 26 and immobilizes the target for 5 sec. Counterattack cannot be blocked, dodged, or parried.

Counterspell.desc: Counters the enemy's spellcast, preventing any spell from that school of magic from being cast for 10 sec. Generates a high amount of threat.

Cower.desc: Cower, causing no damage but lowering your threat a small amount, making the enemy less likely to attack you.

Create Firestone.desc: Creates a Lesser Firestone which can be used to enchant your weapon with Fire, increasing your spell critical strike chance by 1% and the damage done by your Fire spells by up to 10. Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

Create Healthstone.desc: Creates a Minor Healthstone that can be used to instantly restore 120 health. Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

Create Spellstone.desc: Creates a Spellstone which can be used to enchant your weapon with Shadow, increasing your spell haste by 1% and the damage done by your Shadow spells by up to 14. Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

Critical Mass.desc: Increases the critical strike chance of your Fire spells by 2%.

Cruelty.desc: Improves your chance to get a critical strike with melee attacks by 5%.

Crusade.desc: Increases all damage dealt by 2%. Increased by an additional 2% against Demon and Undead targets.

Cultivation.desc: Cultivate a nearby herb, growing a duplicate you can harvest without requiring Herbalism skill. Each herb may only be cultivated once.

Curse of Recklessness.desc: Curses the target with recklessness, reducing the target's armor by 175 for 120 sec. Cursed enemies will not flee and will ignore Fear and Horror effects. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

Curse of Shadow.desc: Curses the target for 180 sec, reducing Shadow and Arcane resistances by 75 and increasing Shadow and Arcane damage taken by 10%. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

Curse of Weakness.desc: Physical damage caused by the target is reduced by 4 for 120 sec. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

Curse of the Elements.desc: Curses the target for 300 sec, reducing Magic resistances by 30 and increases Magic damage taken by 4%. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

Dash.desc: Increases movement speed by 50% for 15 sec. Does not break prowling.

Death Wish.desc: When activated, increases your Physical damage done by 20% and makes you immune to Fear effects, but increases all damage you take by 5%. Lasts 30 sec.

Defiance.desc: Increases all threat generated in Defensive stance by an additional 15% while a shield is equipped.

Demon Skin.desc: Protects the caster, increasing armor by 40 and increases health regeneration by 3 health per 5 sec. for 1800 sec.

Demonic Energies.desc: You heal your pet for 15% of all spell damage you deal. When you gain Mana from Life Tap, your summoned demon gains 100% of the Mana you gain.

Demonic Knowledge.desc: Increases your spell damage and your Demon pet's spell damage by up to 100% of your level while you have a summoned Demon pet active.

Demonic Pact.desc: Your Demonic Sacrifice effect is no longer cancelled by summoning a different Demon pet. Resummoning the sacrificed pet will still cancel the effect.

Demoralizing Roar.desc: The druid roars, decreasing nearby enemies' melee attack power by 46. Lasts 30 sec.

Demoralizing Screech.desc: Blasts a single enemy for 8 damage and lowers the melee attack power of all enemies in melee range by 41 for 30 sec.

Destructive Reach.desc: Increases the range of your damaging spells by 20%.

Deterrence.desc: When activated, increases your Dodge and Parry chance by 25% for 10 sec.

Devastation.desc: Increases the critical strike chance of your Destruction spells by 5%.

Devouring Contagion.desc: Reduces the mana cost of your Devouring Plague by 50%. Targets that die while Devouring Plague is active spreads it, jumping to a nearby enemy within 10 yds for the remaining duration.

Dire Bear Form.desc: Shapeshift into Dire Bear Form, increasing Attack Power by 120, Armor contribution from items by 360%, and Health by 600. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and allows the use of various bear abilities. The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

Dirty Tricks.desc: Reduces the Energy cost of your Sap and Blind abilities by 50%.

Disarm.desc: Disarm the enemy's weapon for 10 sec.

Disengage.desc: Attempts to disengage from the target by reducing threat. Disables auto-attack.

Dismember.desc: Increases the damage of your next melee swing by 100 and causes the target to bleed

Dive.desc: Increases movement speed by 40% for 15 sec.

Divine Favor.desc: When activated, gives your next Flash of Light, Holy Light, or Holy Shock spell a 100% critical effect chance.

Divine Grace.desc: Instantly heals a friendly target below 50% Health for 149 and removes Weakened Soul from that target. Cannot be cast on self.

Divine Precision.desc: Improves your chance to hit with Holy spells by 18%.

Divine Spirit.desc: Holy power infuses the target, increasing their Spirit by 17 for 3600 sec.

Dual Wield Specialization.desc: Increases the damage done by your off-hand weapon by 50%.

Dust Cloud.desc: Reduces nearby enemies' chance to hit with attacks by 30% for 12 sec.

Early Demise.desc: Increases Shadow Word: Death's critical strike chance on targets at or below 20% health by 30%.

Earth Shock.desc: Instantly shocks the target with concussive force, causing 18 Nature damage. It also interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 2 sec. Causes a high amount of threat.

Earth's Grasp.desc: Increases the health of your Stoneclaw Totem by 25% and the radius of your Earthbind Totem by 10%.

Efficiency.desc: Reduces the Mana cost of your Shots, Stings, and melee abilities by 15%.

Elemental Fury.desc: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Searing and Magma Totems and your Fire, Frost, and Nature spells by 100%.

Elemental Insight.desc: Damage dealt versus Elementals increased by 5%.

Elemental Precision.desc: Improves your chance to hit with Frost and Fire spells by 6%.

Elemental Warding.desc: Reduces damage taken from Fire, Frost, and Nature effects by 4%.

Elemental Weapons.desc: Increases the melee attack power bonus of your Rockbiter Weapon by 7%, your Windfury Weapon effect by 13% and increases the damage caused by your Flametongue Weapon and Frostbrand Weapon by 5%.

Elune's Light.desc: Increases your critical strike chance with all spells and attacks by 10% for 15 sec.

Endurance.desc: Reduces the cooldown of your Sprint and Evasion abilities by 60%.

Endurance Training.desc: Increases the Health and Armor of your pets by 15%.

Enhancing Totems.desc: Increases the effect of your Strength of Earth and Grace of Air Totems by 8%.

Escape Artist.desc: Instantly escape the effects of any movement impairing effect and gain immunity to those effects for 3 sec.

Evasion.desc: The rogue's dodge chance will increase by 50% for 15 sec.

Evocation.desc: While channeling this spell, your mana regeneration is active and increased by 1500%. Lasts 8 sec.

Exorcism.desc: Causes 79 Holy damage to an Undead or Demon target.

Eye for an Eye.desc: All critical strikes against you cause 15% of the damage taken to the attacker as well. The damage caused by Eye for an Eye will not exceed 50% of the Paladin's total health.

Fade.desc: Fade out, discouraging enemies from attacking you for 10 sec.

Faerie Fire.desc: Decrease the armor of the target by 175 for 40 sec. While affected, the target cannot stealth or turn invisible.

Fear.desc: Strikes fear in the enemy, causing it to run in fear for up to 10 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect. Only 1 target can be feared at a time.

Fear Ward.desc: Wards the friendly target against Fear. The next Fear effect used against the target will fail, using up the ward. Lasts 180 sec.

Feign Death.desc: Feign death which may trick enemies into ignoring you. Lasts 360 sec. If not cancelled, after 360 sec you will actually die.

Feint.desc: Performs a feint, causing no damage but lowering your threat by a small amount, making the enemy less likely to attack you.

Fel Concentration.desc: Gives you a 70% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while channeling or casting your Drain Life, Drain Mana, Drain Soul, or Wrack spells.

Fel Vitality.desc: Increases the maximum health and Mana of your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter by 15%, and increases your maximum Mana by 15%.

Feral Swiftness.desc: Increases your movement speed while in Cat Form by 30%, and increases your chance to Dodge by 4%.

Find Fish.desc: Nearby fishing nodes appear on the minimap.

Fire Blast.desc: Blasts the enemy for 28 Fire damage.

Fire and Brimstone.desc: Increases the critical strike chance of your Conflagrate spell by 25%.

Flawless Execution.desc: Reduces the Energy cost of your Eviscerate ability by 10.

Focused Fire.desc: Increases all damage you and your pet deal by 2% while your pet is active.

Force of Will.desc: Increases your spell damage by 1% and the critical strike chance of your offensive spells by 1%.

Frenzied Regeneration.desc: Converts up to 10 Rage per second into health for 10 sec. Each point of Rage is converted into 1% health.

Frost Channeling.desc: Reduces the mana cost of your Frost spells by 15% and reduces the threat caused by your Frost spells by 30%.

Frost Shock.desc: Instantly shocks the target with frost, causing 66 Frost damage and slowing movement speed by 50%. Lasts 8 sec.

Furious Howl.desc: Increases the Strength of nearby party members by 5 for 15 sec.

Ghost Wolf.desc: Turns the Shaman into a Ghost Wolf, increasing speed by 40%. Only useable outdoors.

Gift of Nature.desc: Increases the effect of all your healing spells by 2%.

Gift of the Wild.desc: Gives the Gift of the Wild to all party and raid members, increasing armor by 324, all attributes by 14 and all resistances by 20 for 3600 sec.

Gourmand.desc: Increases the duration of beneficial effects from eating food by 100%.

Greater Heal.desc: A slow casting spell that heals a single target for 844.

Grim Reach.desc: Increases the range of your Affliction spells by 20%.

Growl.desc: Taunt the target, increasing the likelihood the creature will focus attacks on you.

Hack and Slash.desc: Increases your chance to get a critical strike with Daggers and Fist Weapons by 5%.

Hawk Eye.desc: Increases the range of your ranged weapons by 6 yards.

Healing Focus.desc: Gives you a 70% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while casting any healing spell.

Healing Light.desc: Increases the amount healed by your Holy Light, Flash of Light, and Holy Shock spells by 4%.

Healing Way.desc: Increases the amount healed by your Healing Wave spell by 33%.

Heart of the Wild.desc: Increases your Intellect by 10%. In addition, while in Bear Form or Dire Bear Form your Stamina is increased by 20% and while in Cat Form your Strength is increased by 10%.

Heroic Strike.desc: A strong attack that increases melee damage by 11 and causes a high amount of threat.

Hex of Weakness.desc: Weakens the target enemy, reducing melee attack power by 43 and reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 20%. Lasts 120 sec.

Holy Conduit.desc: Reduces the mana cost of your Consecration, Holy Wrath, Exorcism, and Hammer of Wrath spells by 40%.

Holy Precision.desc: Improves your chance to hit with Holy spells by 18%.

Holy Shock.desc: Blasts the target with Holy energy, causing 134 Holy damage to an enemy, or 114 healing to an ally.

Holy Specialization.desc: Increases the critical effect chance of your Holy spells by 1%.

Holy Strike.desc: An instant strike that causes 25% weapon damage plus an additional 12 as Holy damage.

Hot Streak.desc: Any time you score 2 spell criticals in a row using using Fireball, Fire Blast, Scorch, Living Bomb, or Frostfire Bolt, you have a chance the next Pyroblast spell cast within 10 sec will be instant cast.

Humanoid Slaying.desc: Increases all damage caused against Humanoid targets by 1% and increases critical damage caused against Humanoid targets by an additional 1%.

Hunter's Mark.desc: Places the Hunter's Mark on the target, increasing the Ranged Attack Power of all attackers against that target by 26. In addition, the target of this ability can always be seen by the hunter whether it stealths or turns invisible. The target also appears on the mini-map. Lasts for 120 sec.

Ice Barrier.desc: Instantly shields you, absorbing 431 damage. Lasts 60 sec. While the shield holds, your spellcasts will not be interrupted or delayed from taking damage.

Ice Block.desc: You become encased in a block of ice, protecting you from all physical attacks and spells for 10 sec, but during that time you cannot attack, move, or cast spells.

Ice Lance.desc: Deals 28 Frost damage to an enemy target. Deals 300% increased damage to Frozen targets.

Ice Shards.desc: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Frost spells by 100%.

Illumination.desc: After getting a critical effect from your Flash of Light, Holy Light, Light's Vigil, or Holy Shock heal spell you have a 0% chance to gain Mana equal to 50% of the base cost of the spell.

Impale.desc: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your abilities by 10%.

Improved Ambush.desc: Increases the critical strike chance of your Ambush ability by 45%.

Improved Aspect of the Hawk.desc: Increases the Ranged Attack Power bonus of your Aspect of the Hawk by 20%.

Improved Bane of Agony.desc: Increases the damage done by your Bane of Agony by 2%.

Improved Battle Shout.desc: Increases the melee attack power bonus of your Battle Shout by 5%.

Improved Blessing of Might.desc: Increases the melee attack power bonus of your Blessing of Might by 4%.

Improved Blessing of Wisdom.desc: Increases the effect of your Blessing of Wisdom spell by 10%.

Improved Bloodrage.desc: Increases all the Rage generated by your Bloodrage ability by 50%.

Improved Channeling.desc: Gives you a 20% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while channeling Arcane Missiles and a 14% chance while casting Arcane Blast.

Improved Concentration Aura.desc: Increases the effect of your Concentration Aura by an additional 15%, and your Concentration Aura also reduces the duration of Silence and Interrupt effects on your party members by 30%.

Improved Curse of Exhaustion.desc: Increases the speed reduction of your Curse of Exhaustion by 5%.

Improved Curse of Weakness.desc: Increases the effect of your Curse of Weakness by 6%.

Improved Demoralizing Shout.desc: Increases the melee attack power reduction of your Demoralizing Shout by 8%.

Improved Devotion Aura.desc: Increases the armor bonus of your Devotion Aura by 5%, and increases all healing received by party members affected by your Auras by 2%.

Improved Drains.desc: Increases health drained or damage done by your Drain Life, Drain Soul, and Wrack spells by 20%.

Improved Entangling Roots.desc: Increases the damage done by your Entangling Roots spell by 75%, and its victims can take up to 75% more damage without interrupting the effect.

Improved Eviscerate.desc: Increases the damage done by your Eviscerate ability by 20%.

Improved Feign Death.desc: Reduces the chance your Feign Death ability will be resisted by 2%.

Improved Firestone.desc: Increases the bonus Fire damage from Firestones and the Firestone effect by 15%.

Improved Healing.desc: Reduces the Mana cost of your Lesser Heal, Heal, Greater Heal, Penance, and Prayer of Mending spells by 15%.

Improved Health Funnel.desc: Increases the amount of health transferred by your Health Funnel spell by 40%, reduces its health cost by 30%, and reduces all threat your Health Funnel generates by 100%. Allows Health Funnel to be used regardless of your demon's health.

Improved Healthstone.desc: Increases the amount of Health restored by your Healthstone by 10%.

Improved Hunter's Mark.desc: Increases the Ranged Attack Power bonus of your Hunter's Mark spell by 3%.

Improved Immolate.desc: Increases the initial damage of your Immolate spell by 5%.

Improved Inner Fire.desc: Increases the Armor bonus of your Inner Fire spell by 45% and increases its total charges by 12.

Improved Life Tap.desc: Increases the amount of Mana awarded by your Life Tap spell by 0%.

Improved Lightning Shield.desc: Increases the damage done by your Lightning Shield orbs by 5%.

Improved Mark of the Wild.desc: Increases the effects of your Mark of the Wild and Gift of the Wild spells by 7%.

Improved Mend Pet.desc: Gives your Mend Pet spell a 50% chance of cleansing 1 Curse, Disease, Magic, or Poison effect from your pet each time it heals and reduces the Mana cost by 20%.

Improved Moonfire.desc: Increases the damage and critical strike chance of your Moonfire spell by 2%.

Improved Overpower.desc: Increases the critical strike chance of your Overpower ability by 25%.

Improved Power Word: Fortitude.desc: Increases the effect of your Power Word: Fortitude and Prayer of Fortitude spells by 15%.

Improved Power Word: Shield.desc: Increases the damage absorbed by your Power Word: Shield by 20%.

Improved Prayer of Healing.desc: Reduces the casting time of your Prayer of Healing by 0 sec.

Improved Regrowth.desc: Increases the critical effect chance of your Regrowth spell by 10%.

Improved Rejuvenation.desc: Increases the effect of your Rejuvenation spell by 5%.

Improved Rend.desc: Increases the Bleed damage done by your Rend ability by 15%.

Improved Renew.desc: Increases the amount healed by your Renew spell by 5%.

Improved Retribution Aura.desc: Increases the damage done by your Retribution Aura by 25%.

Improved Revenge.desc: Increases damage dealt by your Revenge ability by 60%.

Improved Righteous Fury.desc: While Righteous Fury is active, all damage taken is reduced by 6%.

Improved Sap.desc: Gives you a 30% chance to return to stealth mode after using your Sap ability.

Improved Sayaad.desc: Increases the effect of your Succubus' and Incubus' Lash of Pain and Soothing Kiss spells by 30%, and increases the duration of your Succubus' and Incubus' Seduction and Lesser Invisibility spells by 30%.

Improved Seal of the Crusader.desc: Increases the melee attack power bonus of your Seal of the Crusader and the Holy damage increase of your Judgement of the Crusader by 5%.

Improved Seals.desc: Increases the damage done by your Seals and Judgements by 3%.

Improved Serpent Sting.desc: Increases the damage done by your Serpent Sting by 10%.

Improved Sinister Strike.desc: Reduces the Energy cost of your Sinister Strike ability by 5.

Improved Slice and Dice.desc: Increases the duration of your Slice and Dice ability by 15%.

Improved Spellstone.desc: Increases the amount of damage absorbed by your Spellstone by 15%.

Improved Sprint.desc: Gives a 100% chance to remove all movement impairing effects when you activate your Sprint ability.

Improved Subjugate Demon.desc: Reduces the Attack Speed and Casting Speed penalty of your Subjugate Demon spell by 2% and reduces the resist chance by 2%.

Improved Tactical Mastery.desc: Tactical Mastery lets you retain up to an additional 15 Rage when you change stances.

Improved Thorns.desc: Increases damage caused by your Thorns spell by 25%.

Improved Tracking.desc: While tracking Beasts, Demons, Dragonkin, Elementals, Giants, Humanoids, or Undead, all damage you deal to the tracked creature type is increased by 5%.

Improved Tranquility.desc: Reduces threat caused by Tranquility by 100% and its cooldown by 60%.

Improved Vampiric Embrace.desc: Increases the percentage healed by your Vampiric Embrace by an additional 5%.

Improved Voidwalker.desc: Increases the effectiveness of your Voidwalker's Torment, Consume Shadows, Sacrifice, and Suffering spells by 30%.

Improved Weapon Totems.desc: Increases the melee attack power bonus of your Windfury Totem by 15% and increases the damage caused by your Flametongue Totem by 6%.

Incinerate.desc: Deals 97 Fire damage to your target and an additional 25% damage if the target is afflicted by Immolate.

Incineration.desc: Increases the critical strike chance of your Fire Blast, Ice Lance, Arcane Blast, and Scorch spells by 6%.

Initiative.desc: Gives you a 100% chance to add an additional combo point to your target when using your Ambush, Garrote, or Cheap Shot ability.

Inner Focus.desc: When activated, reduces the Mana cost of your next spell by 100% and increases its critical effect chance by 25% if it is a non-periodic spell and capable of a critical effect.

Iron Creed.desc: Reduces the damage taken from all attacks by 0% for 6 sec.

Iron Will.desc: Reduces the duration of Stun and Fear effects inflicted on you by 15%.

Judgement.desc: Unleash the energy of a Seal spell upon an enemy. Does not consume the Seal. Refer to individual Seals for Judgement effect.

Kick.desc: A quick kick that injures a single foe for 15 damage. It also interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 5 sec.

Kidney Shot.desc: Finishing move that stuns the target. Lasts longer per combo point: 1 point : 1 second 2 points: 2 seconds 3 points: 3 seconds 4 points: 4 seconds 5 points: 5 seconds

Killer Instinct.desc: Increases your critical strike chance with all attacks by 3%.

King of the Jungle.desc: Tiger's Fury now instantly grants you 60 Energy.

Lava Burst.desc: You hurl molten lava at the target, dealing 164 Fire damage. If your Flame Shock is on the target, Lava Burst deals 20% increased damage.

Lay on Hands.desc: Heals a friendly target for an amount equal to the Paladin's maximum health. Drains all of the Paladin's remaining Mana when used, but does not interrupt Mana regeneration.

Lethal Attacks.desc: Increases your critical strike chance with all attacks by 1%.

Lethal Shots.desc: Increases your critical strike chance with ranged weapons by 2%.

Lethality.desc: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Sinister Strike, Gouge, Backstab, Mutilate, Ghostly Strike, and Hemorrhage abilities by 6%.

Light's Vigil.desc: The caster's next Holy Shock on this target will activate Light's Vigil, healing the target and their party for 324.

Lightning Bolt.desc: Casts a bolt of lightning at the target for 14 Nature damage.

Lightning Breath.desc: Breathes lightning at an enemy, inflicting Nature damage.

Lightning Overload.desc: Gives your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells a 30% chance to cast a second, similar spell on the same target at no additional cost that causes half damage and no threat.

Litany of Light.desc: When you cast a healing spell, gain Mana equal to 20% of the base cost of the spell if your previous heal was a different spell.

Luremaster.desc: While fishing with a Lure active, you have a 50% chance to catch an extra fish.

Mace Specialization.desc: Increases your damage with One-Handed Maces by 1.

Mage Armor.desc: Increases your resistance to all magic by 5 and allows 50% of your mana regeneration to continue while casting. Only one type of Armor spell can be active on the Mage at any time. Lasts 1800 sec.

Magic Absorption.desc: Increases all your resistances by 2 and causes all spells you fully resist to restore 1% of your total mana. Cannot trigger more often than 1 time per sec.

Malediction.desc: Increases all periodic damage done by your Warlock spells by 10%.

Malevolence.desc: Your damage spells have a chance to cause your target to take up to 50 increased damage from subsequent spells.

Malice.desc: Increases your critical strike chance with all attacks and Poisons by 5%.

Mark of the Wild.desc: Increases the friendly target's armor by 34 for 3600 sec.

Master Chef.desc: Your cooking recipes have a 30% chance to create an extra result.

Master Demonologist.desc: Grants both the Warlock and the summoned demon an effect as long as that demon is active. Imp - Increases Fire damage done by 10%. Voidwalker - Reduces Physical damage taken by 10%. Succubus/Incubus - Increases Shadow damage done by 10%. Felhunter - Reduces Magic damage taken by 10%.

Maul.desc: Increases the druid's next attack by 18 damage.

Meditation.desc: Allows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

Mend Pet.desc: Heals your pet 20 health every second while you focus. Lasts 5 sec.

Mental Agility.desc: Reduces the mana cost of your Smite, Holy Fire, and instant cast spells by 10%.

Mental Dexterity.desc: Increases your Attack Power by an amount equal to 100% of your Intellect.

Mental Quickness.desc: Increases your spell damage and healing by up to 30% of your Intellect.

Mind Blast.desc: Blasts the target for 39 Shadow damage, but causes a high amount of threat.

Mindfulness.desc: Allows 5% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

Mine!.desc: Grabs an enemy's weapon with its talons, causing 11 damage and disarming them for 4 sec.

Mocking Blow.desc: A mocking attack that causes 22 damage, a moderate amount of threat and forces the target to focus attacks on you for 6 sec.

Mongoose Bite.desc: Counterattack the enemy for melee weapon damage plus 15. Can only be performed after you dodge.

Monster Slaying.desc: Increases all damage caused against Beasts, Giants and Dragonkin targets by 2% and increases critical damage caused against Beasts, Giants and Dragonkin targets by an additional 2%.

Moonfury.desc: Increases the damage done by your Arcane and Nature spells by 2%.

Moonglow.desc: Reduces the Mana cost of your damaging spells by 25%.

Mortal Shots.desc: Increases the critical strike damage bonus on all ranged abilities by 30%.

Mortal Strike.desc: A vicious strike that deals weapon damage plus 85 and wounds the target, reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 50% for 10 sec.

Natural Grace.desc: Reduces the threat generated by your spells by 30%.

Natural Shapeshifter.desc: Reduces the mana cost of all shapeshifting by 10%.

Nature's Focus.desc: Gives you a 14% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while casting Arcane and Nature spells.

Nature's Guidance.desc: Improves your chance to hit by 1%.

Nature's Majesty.desc: Increases your critical strike chance with spells and melee attacks by 1%.

Nature's Reach.desc: Increases the range of your offensive Balance spells by 20% and improves your chance to hit by 4%.

Nature's Swiftness.desc: When activated, your next Nature spell with a casting time less than 10 sec. becomes an instant cast spell.

Nightfall.desc: Gives your Corruption, Drain Soul, Drain Life, and Wrack spells a 4% chance to cause you to enter a Shadow Trance after damaging the opponent. The Shadow Trance reduces the casting time of your next Shadow Bolt spell by 100%.

Omen of Clarity.desc: Your spells and attacks have a chance to grant you Clearcasting, reducing the Mana, Rage, or Energy cost of your next damage or healing spell or offensive ability by 100%. Clearcasting is not consumed by Wrath or by spells or abilities that cost no resources.

One-Handed Weapon Specialization.desc: Increases the damage you deal with one-handed melee weapons by 2%.

Opportunity.desc: Increases the damage dealt by your Backstab, Garrote, Ambush, and Mutilate abilities by 10%.

Overgrowth.desc: Increases the maximum number of targets you may have affected by Entangling Roots by 2.

Overpower.desc: Instantly overpower the enemy, causing weapon damage plus 5. Only useable after the target dodges. The Overpower cannot be blocked, dodged or parried.

Pandemic.desc: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Corruption, Bane of Agony, Bane of Doom, Drain Soul, Drain Life, Siphon Life, and Wrack spells by 100%.

Parry.desc: Gives a chance to parry enemy melee attacks.

Pathfinding.desc: Increases the speed bonus of your Aspect of the Cheetah and Aspect of the Pack by 6%.

Performance Bonus.desc: You have a 15% chance to receive 100% increased Merchant's Favor when you turn in a crate to the Azeroth Commerce Authority or Durotar Supply and Logistics.

Permafrost.desc: Increases the duration of your Chill effects by 33% and reduces the target's speed by an additional 10%.

Permanence.desc: Your class abilities which grant long-duration stat or attribute benefits to all party or raid members last 100% longer, and the benefits you gain from resting at a camp last 50% longer.

Pick Lock.desc: Allows opening of locked chests and doors.

Piercing Howl.desc: Causes all nearby enemies to be Dazed, reducing movement speed by 50% for 6 sec.

Piercing Ice.desc: Increases the damage done by your Frost spells by 2%.

Pinch.desc: Pinches an enemy's legs for 20 damage and reduces movement speed by 50% for 9 sec.

Plainsrunning.desc: Increases your running speed. The longer you run the faster you go up to a maximum speed. You cannot use plainsrunning in combat, underwater, or Indoors.

Polymorph.desc: Transforms the enemy into a sheep, forcing it to wander around for up to 20 sec. While wandering, the sheep cannot attack or cast spells but will regenerate very quickly. Any damage will transform the target back into its normal form. Only one target can be polymorphed at a time. Only works on Beasts, Humanoids and Critters.

Portal of Summoning.desc: Begins a ritual that creates a summoning portal. The summoning portal can be used by 2 party or raid members to summon a targeted party or raid member. The ritual portal requires the caster and 2 additional party or raid members to complete. In order to participate, all players must be out of combat and right-click the portal and not move until the ritual is complete.

Power Word: Fortitude.desc: Power infuses the target, increasing their Stamina by 4 for 3600 sec.

Power in Light.desc: Your Smite and Penance spells deal 15% increased damage to targets afflicted with your Holy Fire.

Precision.desc: Improves your chance to hit by 1%.

Predator's Edge.desc: Increases your melee critical strike damage by 30% and your Off Hand weapon damage by 50%.

Predatory Strikes.desc: Increases your melee Attack Power in Cat Form, Bear Form, and Dire Bear Form by 50% of your level.

Premeditation.desc: Adds 2 Combo Points to your target. You must add to or use those combo points within 20 sec or the combo points are lost.

Preparation.desc: When activated, this ability immediately finishes the cooldown on your other Rogue abilities.

Presence of Mind.desc: When activated, your next Mage spell with a casting time less than 10 sec becomes an instant cast spell.

Primal Bite.desc: Bite the target, dealing 100% normal damage plus 26 and generating a high amount of threat.

Prowl.desc: Allows the Druid to prowl around, but reduces your movement speed by 40%. Lasts until cancelled.

Pummel.desc: Pummel the target for 20 damage. It also interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 4 sec.

Puncturing Wounds.desc: Increases the critical strike chance of your Backstab by 30% and your Mutilate by 15%, and gives Backstab a 45% chance to add an additional Combo Point.

Purifying Power.desc: Reduces the mana cost of your Cleanse and Purify spells by 20% and reduces the cooldown of your Exorcism and Holy Wrath spells by 50%.

Pursuit of Justice.desc: Increases movement speed and mounted movement speed by 15%. This does not stack with other movement speed increasing effects.

Quietus.desc: Inflicts 12000% weapon damage and sets the target ablaze, dealing Radiant damage over 9 sec.

Rapid Fire.desc: Increases ranged and melee attack speed by 40% for 15 sec.

Raptor Strike.desc: A strong attack that deals melee weapon damage plus 5.

Recklessness.desc: The warrior will gain 100% increased critical strike chance and will be immune to Fear effects for the next 15 sec, but all damage taken is increased by 20%.

Reflection.desc: Allows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

Reincarnation.desc: Allows you to resurrect yourself upon death with 20% health and mana.

Relentless Strikes.desc: Your finishing moves have a 0% chance per Combo Point to restore 25 Energy.

Rend and Tear.desc: Increases damage done by your melee abilities on Bleeding targets by 20%.

Repentance.desc: Puts the enemy target in a state of meditation, incapacitating them for up to 6 sec. Any damage caused will awaken the target. Only works against Humanoids.

Restless Blades.desc: Your damaging finishing moves reduce the remaining cooldown on your Adrenaline Rush, Blade Flurry, Evasion, Sprint, and Vanish abilities by 2 sec per combo point.

Restorative Totems.desc: Increases the effect of your Mana Spring Totem by 5% and increases the effect of your Healing Stream Totem by 5%.

Revenge.desc: Instantly counterattack an enemy for 22 damage and a high amount of threat. Revenge must follow a block, dodge or parry.

Reverence.desc: Allows 30% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

Righteous Fury.desc: Increases the threat generated by your Holy attacks by 60%. Lasts 1800 sec.

Ritual of Summoning.desc: Begins a ritual that summons the targeted group member. Requires the caster and 2 additional party members to complete the ritual. In order to participate, all players must be out of combat and right-click the portal and not move until the ritual is complete.

Rockbiter Weapon.desc: Imbue the Shaman's weapon, increasing melee attack power by 29 and allowing melee attacks to cause additional threat when using that weapon. Lasts for 60 minutes.

Ruin.desc: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Destruction spells by 100%.

Ruthlessness.desc: Gives your finishing moves a 60% chance to add a Combo Point to your target.

Sacred Arbiter.desc: Increases the damage of your Holy Strike ability by 20% and causes it to refresh all Judgement effects on the target.

Sanctified Judgement.desc: Gives your Judgement ability a 100% chance to return 60% of the Mana cost of the judged seal.

Sap.desc: Incapacitates the target for up to 25 sec. Only works on Humanoids that are not in combat. Any damage taken will break the effect. Only 1 target may be sapped at a time. Does not break Stealth.

Savage Fury.desc: Increases the damage caused by your Claw, Rake, Shred, Maul, and Swipe abilities by 20%.

Savage Strikes.desc: Increases the critical strike chance of all your melee abilities by 20%.

Scorch.desc: Scorch the enemy for 39 Fire damage.

Scorpid Sting.desc: Stings the target, reducing the target's chance to hit with attacks by 2% for 20 sec. Only one Sting per Hunter can be active on any one target.

Seal Fate.desc: Your critical strikes from abilities that add Combo Points have a 0% chance to add an additional Combo Point.

Searing Light.desc: Increases your Holy damage done by 10%, and gives a 10% chance each time your Holy Fire spell deals periodic damage for your next Holy Nova to cost no Mana.

Searing Pain.desc: Inflict searing pain on the enemy target, causing 23 Fire damage. Causes a high amount of threat.

Serrated Blades.desc: Causes your attacks to ignore 9% of your target's Armor and increases the damage dealt by your Rupture ability by 30%.

Setup.desc: Gives you a 0% chance to add a Combo Point to your target after Dodging one of their attacks or fully resisting one of their spells.

Shadow Affinity.desc: Reduces the threat generated by your Shadow spells by 8%.

Shadow Bolt.desc: Sends a shadowy bolt at the enemy, causing 13 Shadow damage.

Shadow Focus.desc: Improves your chance to hit with Shadow spells by 5%.

Shadow Reach.desc: Increases the range of your offensive Shadow spells by 20%.

Shadow Word: Death.desc: A word of dark binding that inflicts 295 Shadow damage to the target. If your target is not killed by Shadow Word: Death, you take backlash damage equal to 10% of your maximum health.

Shadowburn.desc: Instantly blasts the target for 66 Shadow damage. If a non-trivial target dies within 8 sec of being hit with Shadowburn, the caster gains a Soul Shard.

Shadowform.desc: Assume Shadowform, increasing your Shadow damage by 10%, reducing the Mana cost of all Shadow spells by 50%, increasing the critical strike damage bonus of your Shadow spells by 100%, and reducing Physical damage taken by you by 15%. However, you may not cast healing spells while in this form.

Shadowmeld.desc: Activate to slip into the shadows, reducing the chance for enemies to detect your presence. Lasts until cancelled or upon moving. Using this ability in combat discourages enemies from attacking you, but increases the cooldown to 2 min.

Shamanistic Focus.desc: Reduces the mana cost of your Shock and Lightning Shield spells by 45%.

Sharpened Claws.desc: Increases your critical strike chance while in Bear Form, Dire Bear Form, or Cat Form by 2%.

Shatter.desc: Increases the critical strike chance of all your spells against Frozen targets by 1%.

Shatter Curse.desc: Instantly removes and grants immunity to all Curses and Banes, and reduces all Magical damage taken by 15% for 8 sec.

Shell Shield.desc: Reduces all damage your pet takes by 50% and increases the time between your pet's attacks by 60%, but deals more damage with each attack. Lasts 12 sec.

Shield Bash.desc: Bashes the target with your shield for 6 damage. It also interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 6 sec.

Shield Slam.desc: Slam the target with your shield, causing 430 damage, increased by your Block Value, and has a 50% chance of dispelling 1 magic effect on the target. Causes a very high amount of threat.

Shield Specialization.desc: Increases your chance to block attacks with a shield by 1% and increases the amount blocked by 5%.

Shield Wall.desc: Reduces the damage taken from all attacks by 60% for 12 sec.

Silence.desc: Silences an enemy, preventing it from casting spells for 6 sec.

Silent Resolve.desc: Reduces the threat generated by your Holy spells by 30% and reduces the duration of Stun, Fear, and Silence effects inflicted on you by 15%.

Slam.desc: Slams the opponent, causing weapon damage plus 16.

Sleight of Hand.desc: Reduces the chance you are critically hit by attacks by 2% and increases the threat reduction of your Feint ability by 20%.

Smite.desc: Smite an enemy for 15 Holy damage.

Sonic Blast.desc: Emits a piercing shriek, inflicting 16 Nature damage and increasing the casting time of all spells by 60% for 30 sec.

Soul Fire.desc: Burn the enemy's soul, causing 377 Fire damage.

Soul Link.desc: When active, 30% of all damage taken by the caster is taken by your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter Demon instead. In addition, both the Demon and the master will inflict 3% more damage. Lasts as long as the Demon is active.

Spirit Weapons.desc: Gives a chance to parry enemy melee attacks, reduces all threat generated by your attacks by 30% while Rockbiter Weapon is not active, and increases all threat generated by 30% while Rockbiter Weapon is active.

Spiritual Focus.desc: Gives your Flash of Light, Holy Light, and Light's Vigil spells a 14% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

Spiritual Guidance.desc: Increases your spell healing by up to 25% of your total Spirit and your spell damage by up to 8% of your total Spirit.

Spiritual Healing.desc: Increases the amount healed by your spells by 2%.

Sprint.desc: Increases the rogue's movement speed by 50% for 15 sec. Does not break stealth.

Starfire.desc: Causes 81 Arcane damage to the target.

Stealth.desc: Allows the rogue to sneak around, but reduces your speed by 50%. Lasts until cancelled.

Stoneform.desc: Increases the caster's armor by 20 for 15 sec.

Stormstrike.desc: Instantly strike for normal weapon damage and increase the damage you deal to the target with your next Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, or Earth Shock spell by 20% for 12 sec.

Strider Kick.desc: A powerful kick that deals 100% melee weapon damage and increases movement speed by 30% for 3 sec.

Subtlety.desc: Reduces the threat generated by your Nature and Arcane spells by 30%.

Summon Dreadsteed.desc: Summons a Dreadsteed, which serves as a mount for the caster.

Summon Felsteed.desc: Summons a Felsteed, which serves as a mount for the caster.

Summon Incubus.desc: Summons an Incubus under the command of the Warlock.

Summon Succubus.desc: Summons a Succubus under the command of the Warlock.

Summon Warhorse.desc: Summons a warhorse, which serves as a mount.

Sunder Armor.desc: Sunders the target's armor, reducing it by 90 per Sunder Armor and causes a high amount of threat. Can be applied up to 5 times. Lasts 30 sec.

Suppression.desc: Improves your chance to hit by 5% and reduces all threat you generate by 20%.

Surefooted.desc: Increases your hit chance by 3% and reduces the duration of movement impairing effects on you by 30%.

Survival Tactics.desc: Increases your chance to hit with your Trap and Feign Death abilities by 17%.

Survivalist's Discipline.desc: Reduces the cooldown of your Trap and Deterrence abilities by 40%.

Swiftmend.desc: Instantly heals a target with an active Rejuvenation or Regrowth effect for an amount equal to the full duration of the periodic effect of one of those spells.

Sword Specialization.desc: Increases your damage with One-Handed Swords by 1.

Talented.desc: You gain talent points every level starting at level 5 instead of starting at level 10, but you still may not have more than 51 total talent points.

Tame Beast.desc: Begins taming a beast to be your companion. Your armor is reduced by 100% while you focus on taming the beast for 20 sec. If you lose the beast's attention for any reason, the taming process will fail. Once tamed, the beast will be very unhappy and disloyal. Try feeding the pet immediately to make it happy.

Taunt.desc: Taunts the target to attack you, but has no effect if the target is already attacking you.

Teleport: Moonglade.desc: Teleports the caster to the Moonglade.

Tendon Rip.desc: Reduces an enemy's movement speed by 25% for 8 sec.

Thorns.desc: Thorns sprout from the friendly target causing 4 Nature damage to attackers when hit. Lasts 600 sec.

Thundering Strikes.desc: Improves your chance to get a critical strike with all spells and attacks by 1%.

Tidal Focus.desc: Reduces the Mana cost of your healing spells by 5% and improves your chance to hit by 5%.

Torment.desc: Taunts the creature, increasing the chance that it will attack the Voidwalker.

Totemic Focus.desc: Reduces the Mana cost of your totems and any spells that summon or move them by 5%.

Totemic Mastery.desc: The radius of your totems that affect friendly targets is increased to 30 yd.

Totemic Projection.desc: Relocates your active totems to the specified location.

Totemic Recall.desc: Returns your totems to the earth, giving you 25% of the mana required to cast each totem destroyed by Totemic Recall.

Toughness.desc: Increases your Armor value from items by 10%.

Track Beasts.desc: Shows the location of all nearby beasts on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

Travel Form.desc: Shapeshift into Travel Form, increasing movement speed by 40%. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects. Only useable outdoors. The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

Trickster's Dance.desc: Increases your pet's chance to Dodge by 50% and decreases the time between your pet's attacks by 30% for 12 sec.

Twilight Focus.desc: Gives you a 70% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while casting any spell.

Twin Disciplines.desc: Increases the damage and healing of your instant cast spells by 5%.

Twist of Light.desc: Reduces the Mana cost of your Seal spells by 20%, and when you replace your Seal of Command, Seal of Righteousness, Seal of Fury, or Seal of Justice with a different Seal, you gain an Echo of that Seal. Your next melee attack applies the replaced Seal's effects, consuming the Echo.

Two-Handed Axes and Maces.desc: Allows you to use Two-Handed Axes and Two-Handed Maces.

Two-Handed Weapon Specialization.desc: Increases the damage you deal with two-handed melee weapons by 1%.

Unbreakable Will.desc: Reduces the duration of Stun, Fear, and Silence effects inflicted on you by 30%.

Unholy Power.desc: Increases all damage done by your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter pets by 10%.

Unleashed Fury.desc: Increases the damage done by your pets and hawks by 20%.

Vampiric Embrace.desc: Afflicts your target with Shadow energy that causes all party members to be healed for 20% of any Shadow spell damage you deal for 30 sec.

Vanguard.desc: Your Charge ability is now usable while in Defensive Stance.

Vengeance.desc: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Arcane and Nature spells by 20%.

Venom.desc: Finishing move that increases the damage of your Poisons by 30% and your chance to apply Poisons by 10%. Lasts longer per combo point: 1 point : 9 sec 2 points: 12 sec 3 points: 15 sec 4 points: 18 sec 5 points: 21 sec

Vile Poisons.desc: Increases the damage dealt by your poisons by 20% and gives your poisons an additional 40% chance to resist dispel effects.

Voice of Truth.desc: Grants you immunity to Silence and Interrupt effects for 6 sec.

Wand Specialization.desc: Increases your damage with Wands by 13%.

Weapon Expertise.desc: Reduces the chance for your attacks to be Dodged or Parried by 2%.

Weapon Mastery.desc: Increases the damage you deal with all weapons by 2%.

Weaponmaster.desc: Gives you a 0% chance to get an extra attack on the same target after dealing damage with your Sword.

Weaponsmith.desc: Allows a blacksmith to make special weapons that are unavailable to the typical artisan blacksmith.

Web.desc: Casts a web over an enemy, immobilizing it for 10 sec.

Well Rested.desc: Your rested experience accumulates 20% faster and your rested experience cap is increased by 20%.

Will of the Forsaken.desc: Instantly removes all Charm, Fear and Sleep effects.

Wind Blessed.desc: Increases your spellcasting, melee, and ranged Haste by 1%.

Wing Clip.desc: Inflicts 5 damage and reduces the enemy target's movement speed by 50% for 10 sec.

Wisp Spirit.desc: Transform into a wisp upon death, increasing movement speed by 75%.

Working Overtime.desc: Increases your chance to gain a skill increase from using any primary, secondary, or class-based tradeskill by 10%.

Wrath.desc: Causes 15 Nature damage to the target.
